correctness.rationale: The sinc kernel follows from the stated Fourier convention. On L²(E,dx/m), its scaled zero-bandwidth limit is a simple rank-one projection with unit gap. Quadratic eigenfunction correction and interval variance gap follow. Finite quadrature corroborates but is not the proof.
